criteria.requirement: Implement icalendar.attendee_update.upsert_attendee/remove_attendee on real component/vCalAddress objects, returning isolated same-class copies. Match URI scheme case-insensitively and preserve the remaining URI exactly, update only supplied parameters (None removes), retain CN/ROLE/RSVP/delegation lists and unrelated attendees. Explicit duplicate error/all and strict missing-remove policies must work; reject malformed addresses, never modify the source or claim all URI parts are case-insensitive.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
